# Refrens

> > Refrens is an AI-powered accounting and ERP platform designed for Indian SMEs, offering GST-compliant invoicing, inventory management, and business automation.

Refrens provides a comprehensive suite of free and premium accounting tools tailored for Indian businesses, with deep integration of GST compliance, e-invoicing, and inventory management. The platform combines traditional accounting features with modern AI capabilities through its Freya AI Assistant.

## Key Topics

- GST Compliance
- E-invoicing
- AI Accounting Agent
- Inventory Management
- Invoice Generation
- E-way Bills
- GSTR Filing
- Cloud Accounting
- Business Automation
- Freelancer Invoicing
- CRM Integration
- Expense Management
- Multi-currency Billing
- Barcode Scanning
- WhatsApp Integration
